Experimental native Mixed Reality prototype. Uses a placed stereo game window with room passthrough. Full tabletop rendering, motion validation, audio, and multiplayer remain unfinished.\n\nImport your own USA SSQE01 Mario Party 9 disc. No game code or game data comes with this APK. A separately compiled private native library is also required; building Mario Party 9 on this headset is not yet supported.

WiiCompiled Mixed Reality development build for Mario Party 9. Requires your own disc and separately compiled game library. Board/minigame progression has been demonstrated; MR placement and remaining audio/graphics need headset validation.

This build validates the disc ID and SHA-256 hashes of main.dol and all 115 game modules.
